method: Static inspection of eight original PNGs with view_image.
findings: EN and zh-TW owner copy clearly says new questions stop, an already handed-off question may start within a few seconds, and work already in progress may finish.
Owner and asker copy remains readable and wraps within the captured phone viewports without clipping, overlap or horizontal overflow.
Phone owner captures clearly separate neutral Resume sharing from red Stop sharing, with distinct retention, expiry and re-grant explanations.
All four phone asker captures show a readable paused badge and bounded-window notice above the unobscured, disabled-looking composer.
Desktop owner cards and action controls remain legible; the lower Stop sharing card is outside these desktop crops.
limitations: Only the eight listed static captures were inspected; no whole-gallery conclusion.
No browser runs, tests or source edits were performed.
Images do not verify dynamic enforcement, timing, real-device behavior or real AD behavior.
